description: pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs lines 366-368: if cert.signature_algorithm != cert.tbs_certificate.signature, returns Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed{index}. RFC 5280 §4.1.1.2 requires these two fields to be identical; a mismatch is a structural violation, not an algorithm whitelist violation. Using AlgorithmNotAllowed for this case is misleading: the algorithm may be in ALLOWED_SIG_ALGS but the fields simply disagree. A distinct error variant (e.g. Error::AlgorithmMismatch or Error::Path wrapping a structural error) would be more accurate.
title: check_algorithm misreports inner/outer mismatch as AlgorithmNotAllowed
